data_frequency: 5-second regularized completed bar grid from NQ.XCME-1-SECOND-LAST-EXTERNAL
causal_guarantees: Features and M1-U scores derived on completed bar boundaries only
Order submission occurs at decision timestamp t; fill executes at t + delta with 1-tick adverse slippage
No future regime boundaries, labels, or terminal outcomes accessible to policy decisions
Persistence clock increments strictly by elapsed observation time
Recovery cancellation condition evaluated strictly on causally observed running peak

tie_breaking_rules.same_timestamp_recovery_and_persistence: Persistence wins if streak >= 60s reached simultaneously
tie_breaking_rules.exit_priority: Health invalidation exit preempts baseline natural flip if triggered at earlier timestamp
